guide_line: Convert a pressure, and read an open manometer.
steps: To a smaller unit, multiply. To a larger unit, divide.
On an open manometer, mercury higher on the open side means the gas pressure is higher. Add the height.
Mercury higher on the gas side means the gas pressure is lower. Subtract the height.
